statement: ∀ (A : LR.Actions M x y h) (b₀ b : Module.Basis (Fin (l+1)) K (LR.VK K M)), LR.ReducedMatrices K l M x y h A b₀ → LR.ReducedMatrices K l M x y h A b → ∃ C : Module.End K (LR.VK K M) ≃ₐ[K] Module.End K (LR.VK K M), C (LR.induced K M A.lx.map) = LR.induced K M A.lx.map ∧ C (LR.induced K M A.ly.map) = LR.induced K M A.ly.map ∧ ∀ i j, C (LR.unit l b₀ i j) = LR.unit l b i j
proof:
intro A b₀ b h₀ hb
let e := b₀.equiv b (Equiv.refl _)
have he (i) : e (b₀ i) = b i := by simp [e]
have hes (i) : e.symm (b i) = b₀ i := by rw [← he, e.symm_apply_apply]
let C := e.conjAlgEquiv (R := K)
refine ⟨C, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· apply b.ext
  intro i
  change e (LR.induced K M A.lx.map (e.symm (b i))) = _
  rw [hes]
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · have hi' : i = 0 := Fin.ext hi
    subst i
    rw [h₀.1, hb.1, map_zero]
  · let j : Fin (l+1) := ⟨i.val-1, by omega⟩
    have hj : j.val+1 = i.val := by dsimp [j]; omega
    rw [h₀.2.1 i j hj, hb.2.1 i j hj, map_smul, he]
· apply b.ext
  intro i
  change e (LR.induced K M A.ly.map (e.symm (b i))) = _
  rw [hes]
  by_cases hi : i.val = l
  · have hi' : i = ⟨l, Nat.lt_succ_self l⟩ := Fin.ext hi
    subst i
    rw [h₀.2.2.2.1, hb.2.2.2.1, map_zero]
  · let j : Fin (l+1) := ⟨i.val+1, by omega⟩
    have hj : j.val = i.val+1 := rfl
    rw [h₀.2.2.1 i j hj, hb.2.2.1 i j hj, map_smul, he]
· intro i j
  apply b.ext
  intro k
  change e (LR.unit l b₀ i j (e.symm (b k))) = _
  rw [hes]
  simp [LR.unit, he, Module.Basis.coord_apply]

checked : ∀ (p : ℕ) (K : Type) [fieldK : Field K] (l : ℕ) (V : Type) [addV : AddCommGroup V] [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V]
  (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ l < p →
    LR.N1 l x y h v →
      (LR.N2 p l M x y v ∧ ∀ (q : ℚ), q ∈ LR.localRing p ↔ ∃ a d, ¬↑p ∣ d ∧ q = ↑a / ↑d) →
        LR.N3 p l M y v →
          (∃ (c : CharP K p), ∃ rho sigma A, LR.ResidueMaps K p c rho sigma) →
            (∀ (c : CharP K p) (rho : LR.R p →+* K) (sigma : LR.R p →+* ZMod p) (A : LR.Actions M x y h),
                LR.ResidueMaps K p c rho sigma → LR.Reduction K p l M x y h v A c rho sigma) →
              ∀ (A : LR.Actions M x y h) (b₀ b : Module.Basis (Fin (l + 1)) K (LR.VK K M)),
                LR.ReducedMatrices K l M x y h A b₀ →
                  LR.ReducedMatrices K l M x y h A b →
                    ∃ C,
                      C (LR.induced K M A.lx.map) = LR.induced K M A.lx.map ∧
                        C (LR.induced K M A.ly.map) = LR.induced K M A.ly.map ∧
                          ∀ (i j : Fin (l + 1)), C (LR.unit l b₀ i j) = LR.unit l b i j
